fix_summary: validate_lines promises to reject empty orders but only checks for orders exceeding MAX_LINES, letting an empty list of lines pass. Add an explicit check to raise ValidationError when lines is empty (e.g., if not lines: raise ValidationError("no lines")).
suggested_test: Create an order with {'region': 'EMEA', 'lines': [], 'contact_email': 'test@example.com'} and assert validation.validate(order) returns False (or that validation.validate_lines(order) raises ValidationError). Also verify that a non-empty order passes.
